en.name: Microdermabrasion
en.meta_title: Microdermabrasion Facial: Exfoliate for Brighter, Smoother Skin
en.meta_description: Reveal a brighter, smoother complexion with a non-invasive microdermabrasion treatment. This gentle exfoliation removes dead skin cells to improve sun damage, fine lines, and acne scarring for a refreshed glow.
en.meta_keywords: microdermabrasion, facial exfoliation, skin rejuvenation, brighter skin, smoother skin, acne scars, fine lines, non-invasive facial

what_is.heading: What is Microdermabrasion? Instantly Refresh Your Skin
paragraphs: Reveal a brighter, smoother complexion with Microdermabrasion. This popular and non-invasive treatment is a form of mechanical exfoliation that gently removes the outermost layer of dead skin cells, unclogging pores and instantly refreshing your skin's appearance.

procedure.heading: The Microdermabrasion Procedure
paragraphs: The procedure uses a diamond-tipped wand to gently abrade the skin's surface while a vacuum suction clears away the exfoliated cells. This process helps to improve the appearance of sun damage, fine lines and wrinkles, age spots, and acne scarring. It's a perfect "lunchtime" procedure as it requires no downtime.

benefits.heading: Benefits for Healthy Skin
paragraphs: Microdermabrasion is suitable for almost all skin types. It enhances the absorption and efficacy of your skincare products and can be performed as a standalone treatment or as part of a comprehensive skin health plan. After a session, your skin will feel softer and look more radiant.
